## Validation
- [ ] Frontend lint passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Frontend build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`mvn -B -f backend/pom.xml test`)

## Review checklist
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials are committed
- [ ] Inputs are validated and errors handled
- [ ] Authorization is enforced server-side where required
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior
- [ ] API / README documentation updated when needed
- [ ] Changes are focused and do not include unrelated files
